leads.text: Agent confirmed Aetna PPO coverage but initially said 'Aetna PTO' (possible typo or speech recognition error) -- clarify if this is a consistent misstatement
Agent cannot directly update patient DOB in system and must route to clinic support team -- test if this limitation affects other data corrections
Requesting a prescription refill when no medications appear in the system -- test if this is expected behavior or a data sync issue

Agent accepts patient's corrected date of birth and routes to clinic support team for update -- test if corrections are actually processed
Agent can schedule follow-up appointments with specific times and send appointment confirmation via text message
Agent spells provider name inconsistently -- 'Dugie Hauser' initially, then 'Dubeyhauser' at end of call -- clarify correct spelling
Provider name spelling remains inconsistent across single call (Doo Dee Hauser → Doogie Howser → Dubehauser → Doobie Hauser) -- clarify correct spelling and whether agent has accurate data
Agent confirms specific appointment times and dates but uses inconsistent provider name spelling -- test if this affects record accuracy in system
Provider name spelling remains highly inconsistent within same call (Dudeehauser → Abreker → Eberker → Judy Hauser) -- clarify correct provider names and test if agent has access to accurate data
Agent can cancel multiple appointments in single call -- test edge cases like attempting to cancel non-existent appointments or testing cancellation process limitations
Agent offers to note Sunday appointment requests for follow-up if something opens up -- verify if office actually follows up on these requests
Agent mentioned 'doctor Kelly Noble' as an available provider option but never confirmed this provider exists or has appointments -- test if this provider is real or if agent generated a false name

Agent initially said patient's DOB was 'July fourth thousand for demo purposes' -- clarify if agent correctly interprets placeholder date instructions or if this is a mishandling of demo account setup

Agent provided patient's phone number (657-566-5136) that patient immediately corrected -- verify if agent has access to correct stored contact information or if this represents a data accuracy problem
Agent said 'It's possible' to patient's question about provider, leaving answer ambiguous -- test if agent can clearly confirm or deny provider assignments without vague responses

Agent initially said 'doctor Judy Hauser' then later corrected to 'doctor Dugi Hauser' within same call -- clarify if agent has inconsistent data or if these are spelling variation issues affecting provider matching

Agent struggled significantly with call flow when patient interrupted with time-sensitive requests (double-parked, low battery) -- test how agent handles impatient callers and multiple simultaneous questions
Agent said 'Pickup' in response to patient name confirmation, which was confusing and unexplained -- clarify what this utterance was intended to mean
Agent offered 'doctor Kelly Noble' as available provider on Tuesday but previously marked as unverified -- verify if Kelly Noble is an actual provider or if agent generated a false name again

Provider name spelling remains inconsistent: 'Zigniew Likoski' mentioned earlier in call, then 'Zigbingo' (garbled), then 'Zebigniew Lakoski' in confirmation -- verify correct spelling and test if agent has reliable provider data

Agent appeared to struggle with audio clarity or call quality during patient requests for information ('cutting out a little') -- test if agent reliably conveys information under poor audio conditions

Patient gave unclear information about appointment purpose (hip vs. scan vs. knee), then asked clinic to clarify -- test how agent handles vague appointment reason requests and whether follow-up notes resolve the ambiguity
Agent says appointment details on file don't specify which visit is for hip concern -- test whether agent should have access to appointment reason/type information or if this is a system limitation
Patient has billing question ('charge on it') -- test if agent can field billing/accounting inquiries or if all non-appointment/non-refill questions should be escalated

Patient requested to ask follow-up question before being transferred ('can I ask you something else real quick') but agent transferred immediately anyway -- test if agent should pause transfers for patient follow-up questions or confirm patient is ready before transferring
Transfer appears to route to 'Pretty Good AI test line' and disconnects with goodbye -- verify if this is a test environment artifact, a broken transfer, or actual patient support transfer behavior
